text_to_image_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Generate a NEW photorealistic clothing-library product photograph inspired by the described reference, not a copy of a screenshot. Pure opaque white #FFFFFF seamless background, bright soft frontal studio lighting, minimal soft contact shadow, crisp realistic fabric texture, true garment colors, no dramatic shadows. Portrait 2:3 canvas, complete centered objects with generous clear margin. Front-facing straight camera. No people, skin, head, neck, hands, legs, body, visible mannequin, stand, hanger, room, typography, logos, brand marks, watermarks, borders or collage. ONE isolated accessory product only: One thin silver chain necklace with a small silver butterfly pendant. Large centered catalog object, realistic material texture and precise polished construction. No clothes, no wearing body or mannequin, no outfit, no additional props. A matched pair or integral components of the same product are allowed only when explicitly described. Show the complete necklace including clasp in a closed oval with generous white margin on every side.
original_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the attached necklace product image. Keep the same pendant design, silver metal, delicate chain, pure white background and soft studio lighting. Reframe to show the ENTIRE closed-loop necklace INCLUDING clasp and ALL of the chain fully inside the image. Lay out the entire necklace in a long closed oval with the pendant at bottom. Zoom out substantially: leave at least 15% white clearance on all four sides. Nothing may cross or touch the top border. Portrait 2:3 image. Only one complete necklace, no other objects, no text.
